0.long_answer: Fondaparinux is a synthetic pentasaccharide factor Xa inhibitor that binds to antithrombin and selectively inhibits factor Xa. It is used in the treatment of heparin-induced thrombocytopenia (HIT) because it does not cross-react with platelet factor 4 (PF4), thereby reducing the risk of further thrombocytopenia. By employing a different mechanism from standard heparin, fondaparinux provides an effective anticoagulant therapy for patients affected by HIT.
